manual.hbm.machine.acidizer.title: Ore Acidizer
manual.hbm.machine.acidizer.content: Processing machine that can turn ores into crystals, which yield more when [[centrifuged|Centrifuge]]. Also used heavily for [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]].
manual.hbm.machine.anvil.title: Anvil
manual.hbm.machine.anvil.content:
One of the first tools used in progression. The anvil GUI has two relevant sections:

The top slots are used for smithing type recipes, like forging meteorite ingots or making [[foundry molds|Foundry Molds]].

The bottom section is for construction, once a recipe is selected, clicking the blue button will perform the recipe. The anvil will use items directly from the inventory.
manual.hbm.machine.arc_welder.title: Arc Welder
manual.hbm.machine.arc_welder.content: Mainly used for producing welded plates as well as assembling missiles. Power demand changes heavily based on recipe. Important for making [[dense copper or gold wires|Dense Wire]] before being able to cast them using the [[crucible|Crucible]], as one sample is required beforehand to make a foundry mold.
manual.hbm.machine.ashpit.title: Ashpit
manual.hbm.machine.ashpit.content: An ashpit can be placed under certain machines to collect ashes. [[Fireboxes|Firebox]] and [[heating ovens|Heating Oven]] will produce types of ash depending on the fuel used. [[Smokestacks|Smokestack]] create fly ash, with industrial smokestacks in particular also producing small amounts of fine soot, the raw material used for making [[fullerite|Fullerite]].
manual.hbm.machine.assembler.title: Assembly Machine
manual.hbm.machine.assembler.content: Universal machine for building things with up to twelve item inputs. Important early on and used widely throughout progression. Built in an [[anvil|Anvil]], using plates from a [[press|Press]].
manual.hbm.machine.autosaw.title: Automatic Buzzsaw
manual.hbm.machine.autosaw.content:
Automatic machine that will cut down trees and plants in a 10 block radius. When supplied with fuel (like wood oil), it will constantly revolve at a slow pace, and only extend if plant or wood blocks are detected. Trees can be felled in full and are replanted if leaves were present. The buzzsaw is designed to be placed on the same level as the trees, so the sawblade should strike the second lowest log block of the tree, however hitting the lowest still works. Sugar cane and cacti can be harvested too, assuming the saw is placed at the same height, so that the blade doesn't break the lowest block. Mustard willows are only cut when mature. Harvested plants will be dropped on the spot, unlike the [[automatic thresher|Automatic Thresher]] which dispenses them from the machine, so a collection system has to be set up, for example employing fans.

Do note that touching the spinning sawblade is not healthy.
manual.hbm.machine.blastfurnace.title: Blast Furnace
manual.hbm.machine.blastfurnace.content: Simple furnace that can combine two items into one output and an optional byproduct, usually in the form of an alloy. Needed early on as the first source of [[steel|Steel]] and [[red copper|Minecraft Grade Copper]]. Does not accept all furnace fuels, only works with hot burning ones like coal, coke, or solid fuel. Accepts hot air blast which accelerates the process up to three times the recipe's intended speed. Produces flue gas, which can be burned for energy or simply flared.
manual.hbm.machine.boiler.title: Boiler
manual.hbm.machine.boiler.content:
Use an [[external heat source|External Heat Source]] to heat up fluids. The input type has to be set with a fluid identifier, with the output being automatically changed to the corresponding hot fluid.

Used early on for heating up water into [[steam|Steam]], to be used in a [[steam engine|Steam Engine]].

Also required for oil refining, as [[refineries|Oil Refinery]] require hot oil.

Standard copper boilers may explode when running full, while industrial boilers will simply stop. Destroyed boilers cannot be repaired.
manual.hbm.machine.centrifuge.title: Centrifuge
manual.hbm.machine.centrifuge.content: Separates items, can be used as a more efficient way of ore processing. Initially mainly used for gathering [[mercury|Mercury]] from redstone ore, required for making [[desh|Desh]].
manual.hbm.machine.chemplant.title: Chemical Plant
manual.hbm.machine.chemplant.content: Universal chemical processor, can be made right after the [[assembly machine|Assembly Machine]]. Used in many processes, with the most important ones early on being [[desh|Desh]], [[polymer|Polymer]], [[hydrogen peroxide|Hydrogen Peroxide]] and [[sulfuric acid|Sulfuric Acid]].
manual.hbm.machine.coker.title: Coker Unit
manual.hbm.machine.coker.content: Can turn many types of oil into [[petroleum coke|Coke]] at varying efficiencies. Usually produces an oil byproduct, which can be processed into [[cracked oil derivatives|Advanced Oil Processing]]. Requires an [[external heat source|External Heat Source]].
manual.hbm.machine.comboven.title: Combination Oven
manual.hbm.machine.comboven.content: A type of oven that can produce solid and liquid outputs. Requires an [[external heat source|External Heat Source]] to function.
manual.hbm.machine.compressor.title: Compressor
manual.hbm.machine.compressor.content: Compresses fluids, i.e. increases the "PU" number of a fluid. Certain fluids change when compressed, for example [[perfluoromethyl|Perfluoromethyl]] turns into cold PFM when compressed to 2 PU. Each compressor can only do a single PU increase. Compressed fluids can use the same pipes as uncompressed fluids (and in fact share the exact same network, as there is no pressure identification), but they cannot be stored in tanks.
manual.hbm.machine.condenser.title: Condenser
manual.hbm.machine.condenser.content:
Turns [[low-pressure steam|Steam]] back into water. A small condenser can handle 100mB/t, an auxiliary cooling tower 1,000mb/t, a large cooling tower 10,000mB/t and a high-power condenser 1,000,000mB/t. The high-power condenser needs electricity to work, all other condensers work passively.

An important part of any closed steam cycle, for example for [[steam engines|Steam Engine]], [[cracking towers|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] or most nuclear reactors.
manual.hbm.machine.crackingtower.title: Catalytic Cracking Tower
manual.hbm.machine.crackingtower.content: Vital for [[advanced oil processing|Advanced Oil Processing]]. Right-click with a fluid identifier to set the input type. Requires [[steam|Steam]] to work, outputs [[low-pressure steam|Low-Pressure Steam]] in addition to its oil output. Mainly used for cracking [[crude oil|Crude Oil]] into [[cracked oil|Cracked Oil]], but can also convert many other types of petrochemicals.
manual.hbm.machine.derrick.title: Oil Derrick
manual.hbm.machine.derrick.content:
The cheapest way of extracting [[oil|Crude Oil]]. When placed on top of an [[oil depsoit|Oil Collection]] and powered, it will slowly drill down and pump up oil and [[natural gas|Natural Gas]]. A less powerful version of the [[pumpjack|Pumpjack]].

A green indicator means that the derrick is currently drilling or pumping up oil. A red indicator means that the drill is jammed, the tanks are full or the derrick is out of power. A crossed out droplet means that the derrick's drill has reached the max depth, and there's no oil to gather.

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.machine.dieselgen.title: Diesel Generator
manual.hbm.machine.dieselgen.content:
A simple, early way of making power out of combustible [[fuels|Fuels]], like [[diesel|Diesel]] or [[gasoline|Gasoline]]. Can be stopped using a redstone signal.

See also:
[[Industrial Combustion Engine]]
[[Turbofan]]
[[Combined Cycle Gas Turbine]]
manual.hbm.machine.electricheater.title: Electric Heater
manual.hbm.machine.electricheater.conten:
An [[external heat source|External Heat Source]] powered by electricity. Needs to be configured with a screwdriver.

Due to the first law of thermodynamics, boiling water with an electric heater will produce less energy than is used to create it.
manual.hbm.machine.firebox.title: Firebox
manual.hbm.machine.firebox.content:
Cheapest type of [[external heat source|External Heat Source]]. Burning things like coal, [[coke|Coke]] or [[solid fuel|Solid Fuel]] increases the TU output as well as the efficiency.

Placing an [[ashpit|Ashpit]] under it will capture ashes, which can be burned again or recycled.
manual.hbm.machine.fracker.title: Hydraulic Fracking Tower
manual.hbm.machine.fracker.content:
The fastest and most efficient way of collecting [[oil|Crude Oil]] from an [[oil deposit|Oil Collection]], compared to a [[derrick|Derrick]] or [[pumpjack|Pumpjack]].

Using it like this is not advised though, as the fracking tower's main advantage is being able to access bedrock oil deposits. Pumping oil out of bedrock deposits is slower, but these deposts will never deplete.

Requires [[fracking solution|Fracking Solution]] in addition to large amounts of power to work, even when using it on regular oil deposits.

Caution: May alter the landscape a little bit.

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
[[Advanced Oil Processing]]
[[Vacuum Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.machine.fractioning.title: Fractioning Tower
manual.hbm.machine.fractioning.content:
Used in many refining processes to extend the [[refinery's|Oil Refinery]] variety of outputs. Splits one fluid into exactly two output fluids. Right-click with a fluid identifier to set the input type. Stacking multiple fractioning towers will combine them, the type has to be set on the lowest one. Input oil travels upwards and output oil travels downwards, so it is advised to always connect pipes to the bottom tower segment. Segments can be split using fraction tower spacers.

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
[[Advanced Oil Processing]]
[[Vacuum Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.machine.heatexchanger.title: Heat Exchanging Heater
manual.hbm.machine.heatexchanger.content:
Powerful [[external heat source|External Heat Source]] usually used by nuclear reactory that employ a form of [[coolant|Perfluoromethyl]] instead of making [[steam|Steam]] outright. Produces usable heats by using hot fluids and cooling them down in the process.

The top field in the GUI is for the amount of fluid used per cycle, the bottom field is for the tick delay between cycles for fine-tuning.
manual.hbm.machine.heatingoven.title: Heating Oven
manual.hbm.machine.heatingoven.content:
Advanced version of the [[firebox|Firebox]], an [[external heat source|External Heat Source]]. Burns 5x hotter, but uses up fuel 8x quicker, making it less efficient. Heating ovens have a copper contact at the bottom, allowing them to be stacked, however they only receive heat from below at half efficiency.

Placing an [[ashpit|Ashpit]] under it will capture ashes, which can be burned again or recycled.
manual.hbm.machine.heatsource.title: External Heat Source
manual.hbm.machine.heatsource.content:
Many machines require TU - thermal units - to function. TU is transfered via copper contacts on the undersides of machines, they cannot be connected with pipes or cables.

Machines that can provide heat are:
[[Firebox]]
[[Heating Oven]]
[[Fluid Burner]]
[[Electric Heater]]
[[Heat Exchanging Heater]]

Machines that use TU include, but are not limited to:
[[Stirling Engine]]
[[Combination Oven]]
[[Boiler]]
[[Steel Furnace]]
[[Crucible]]
manual.hbm.machine.ice.title: Industrial Combustion Engine
manual.hbm.machine.ice.content:
An improved engine using combustible [[fuels|Fuels]]. The efficiency of the fuel grade used depends on the installed piston set. Will not work if no piston set is installed. Flow rate can be adjusted in the GUI.

See also:
[[Diesel Generator]]
[[Turbofan]]
[[Combined Cycle Gas Turbine]]
manual.hbm.machine.mixer.title: Industrial Mixer
manual.hbm.machine.mixer.content: Can combine two fluids and one item into a single fluid. The recipe is defined by setting the output fluid with a fluid identifier. If an output has multiple possible recipes, the recipe can be changed using the [C] button.
manual.hbm.machine.oilburner.title: Fluid Burner
manual.hbm.machine.oilburner.content: An [[external heat source|External Heat Source]] powered by flammable fluids, usually derivatives of [[oil|Crude Oil]]. Needs to be turned on in the GUI to function. The flow rate can be increased using a screwdriver, from 1mB/t to 10mB/t.
manual.hbm.machine.press.title: Press
manual.hbm.machine.press.content:
One of the earliest machines, used for making things like plates and wires. A burner press requires a solid fuel like coal to run, as well as a stamp of the desired shape. Stamps are crafted as flat stamps, which are only used in a few recipes, most recipes require the stamp to be turned into a plate or wire stamp using the template folder.

Electric presses are much faster and require electricity to run instead of fuel.

Conveyor presses also run on electricity, and can press single items that pass on its conveyor belt. The conveyor press has no GUI, stamps can be removed with a screwdriver.
manual.hbm.machine.pumpjack.title: Pumpjack
manual.hbm.machine.pumpjack.content:
A faster and more efficient way of extracting [[oil|Crude Oil]]. When placed on top of an [[oil depsoit|Oil Collection]] and powered, it will slowly drill down and pump up oil and [[natural gas|Natural Gas]]. A more powerful version of the [[oil derrick|Derrick]].

A green indicator means that the derrick is currently drilling or pumping up oil. A red indicator means that the drill is jammed, the tanks are full or the derrick is out of power. A crossed out droplet means that the derrick's drill has reached the max depth, and there's no oil to gather.

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.machine.pyrooven.title: Pyrolysis Oven
manual.hbm.machine.pyrooven.content: A machine available after [[vacuum oil processing|Vacuum Oil Processing]] which plays a similar role as the [[coker unit|Coker Unit]]. Instead of [[petroleum coke|Coke]], it makes the more powerful [[solid fuel|Solid Fuel]]. Also has several recipes for [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore]] shared with the [[combination oven|Combination Oven]], for making [[syngas|Syngas]], and for making [[fine soot|Ashpit]].
manual.hbm.machine.refinery.title: Oil Refinery
manual.hbm.machine.refinery.content: Used for [[processing|Basic Oil Processing]] either [[crude oil|Crude Oil]] or [[cracked oil|Cracked Oil]]. Oil needs to be heated in a [[boiler|Boiler]] beforehand. Has four fluid outputs and one solid output.
manual.hbm.machine.rotaryfurnace.title: Rotary Furnace
manual.hbm.machine.rotaryfurnace.content:
A type of alloying furnace that can accept multiple item inputs and a fluid and output the result as liquid metal which needs to be cast. Used to make [[weapon steel|Weapon Steel]] and [[saturnite|Saturnite]], and features alternate recipes for [[gunmetal|Gunmetal]] and [[steel|Steel]]. Requires both a solid fuel and [[steam|Steam]] to function, creating [[low-pressure steam|Low-Pressure Steam]] in the process.

Items can be inserted from the color-coded access points in the back. The input fluid can only be connected to one of the two grey ports on the output side. Steam and low-pressure steam ducts need to be connected to the steam engine on the left. Solid fuel can be inserted through the iron bars at the front. Exhaust smoke can be extracted from the opening at the top, the furnace will emit a smoke plume if not connected to a smoke stack.
manual.hbm.machine.shredder.title: Shredder
manual.hbm.machine.shredder.content: Allows ores to be shredded into powder, which doubles the yield. Any item that has no recipe will be shredded anyway, and turned to scrap. Requires two shredder blades to work, blades made from [[desh|Desh]] will never break. Will process one item from every slot at the same time, so filling all slots will make it run more efficiently.
manual.hbm.machine.solarboiler.title: Solar Tower Boiler
manual.hbm.machine.solarboiler.content:
The solar tower boiler is a simple machine that can turn water into steam. It requires focused sunlight to do so, coming from heliostat mirrors. Right-click the boiler to save its position, then click on the mirrors that should be pointed at this boiler. Mirrors cannot be tilted past 45°, so it is important to put the boiler at an elevated position (hence solar TOWER boiler). In other words: The horizontal distance between the mirrors and the boiler cannot exceed the vertical distance. Consequently, the higher up the boiler is, the more mirrors can be connected to it.

Due to the boiler running off of sunlight, it will not work during the night. But you already knew that. Sunlight is also not very powerful, so in order to bring water to a boil, about a dozen mirrors are required at minimum.

The boiler has no GUI, nor can water be inserted directly, it needs to be supplied via pipes. The resulting steam can then be used in a [[steam engine|Steam Engine]], yielding power and low-pressure steam, which can then be [[condensed|Condenser]] back into usable water.
manual.hbm.machine.steamengine.title: Steam Engine
manual.hbm.machine.steamengine.content:
The earliest way of making power out of [[steam|Steam]], usually from a [[boiler|Boiler]]. Outputs [[low-pressure steam|Steam]], which either has to be vented or [[condensed|Condenser]] back into water.

Can only handle regular pressure steam, higher pressures require a [[steam turbine|Steam Turbine]].
manual.hbm.machine.steelfurnace.title: Steel Furnace
manual.hbm.machine.steelfurnace.content: A furnace powered by an [[external heat source|External Heat Source]]. Can run three recipes at the same time. Certain recipes, like smelting ores or logs, have a bonus output, indicated by the small meter below the progress bar. Not particularly fast due to the heat transfer limitation, but very versatile.
manual.hbm.machine.stirling.title: Stirling Engine
manual.hbm.machine.stirling.content:
Early machine for turning [[TU|External Heat Source]] directly into energy. Has low efficiency, and can only accept limited amounts of heat. Too much heat will cause the machine to violently disassemble. Detached parts can be collected and slotted back into the machine.

A step up from the [[wood burner|Wood-Burning Generator]], but not by much.
manual.hbm.machine.thresher.title: Automatic Thresher
manual.hbm.machine.thresher.content:
Automatic machine that will harvest crops and plants in a 7x7 area. When supplied with fuel (like wood oil), it will extend in intervals between 10-15 seconds, even if no blocks can be harvested. Crops like wheat and carrots will be replanted automatically when harvested. Sugar cane and cacti can be harvested too, if the lowest block is hit by the thresher then it will be kept, and only the upper blocks are broken. Also works on double plants like hemp and mustard willow, where only the upper block is removed, regardless of where the thresher hits the plant. Mustard willows are only harvested when mature. Sunflowers and tall grass also yield items, but due to them not being growable crops, they aren't broken at all, only yielding sunflowers and wheat seeds respectively at a low rate. Unlike the [[automatic buzzsaw|Automatic Buzzsaw]], the thresher will collect the harvested items and eject them at the back of the machine.

Hostile mobs struck by the thresher's reel will yield small piles of nitra on death. The operating parts are still dangerous to players and passive mobs, though.
manual.hbm.machine.turbofan.title: Turbofan
manual.hbm.machine.turbofan.content:
An advanced generator using aviation-grade combustible fuel like [[kerosene|Kerosene]]. Can be stopped by supplying a redstone signal to one of its ports. Beware its intake.

See also:
[[Diesel Generator]]
[[Industrial Combustion Engine]]
[[Combined Cycle Gas Turbine]]
manual.hbm.machine.woodburner.title: Wood-Burning Generator
manual.hbm.machine.woodburner.content: The first available way of making power. Can burn solid or liquid fuels, the operating mode may be changed by clicking the arrow button. Burns wooden logs and planks more efficiently. Cables and pipes can be connected at the back.
commands.hbm.locate.usage: /ntmlocate structure <name> - Locates the nearest structure with a given name.
commands.hbm.locate.busy: An NTM structure search is already in progress.
commands.hbm.locate.failed: The structure search failed or its generation settings changed; run the command again.
commands.hbm.wiki_render.usage: - Render screenshots of a selected item type (e.g ItemGunBaseNT). Intended for developers and wiki editors only.
manual.hbm.concepts.fluidid.title: Concept: Fluid Identification
manual.hbm.concepts.fluidid.content:
An important concept in NTM that is not commonly seen in other mods is fluid identification. While many mods have pipes that allow any fluid to pass, and tanks that simply assume the first type of fluid that is inserted, in NTM, all pipes and tanks need their type defined before they can be used. This has the inherent advantage that there is never any ambiguity as to what fluid can be in a given pipeline or tank, and systems with many pipelines next to each other, or tanks with many passing pipes, will always be separated due to pipes of different types never connecting.

Fluid types are usually defined via a fluid identifier, shift-click will open the GUI which allows up to two types to be saved (with left and right click), and right click in the air will switch the primary and secondary saved type (only the primary type is used when identifying). Fluid containers, pipes and boilers can be identified with right click, and shift-click will identify all connected pipes of the same type (with a maximum distance of 64 blocks). Other machines may feature a fluid identifier slot instead, simply insert the fluid identifier item into the slot and the type of the connected fluid tank will change.

Some machines feature no slot at all, either their fluid types are static and cannot be changed due to restrictions of how the machine works, or the machine has a different way of changing types, like a recipe selector switch.
manual.hbm.fluids.antimatter.title: Antimatter
manual.hbm.fluids.antimatter.content:
Antimatter can be produced using a [[particle accelerator|Particle Detector]] or as a byproduct from the [[cyclotron|Cyclotron]]. It can be used to produce some [[RBMK]] fuels, or as a component of [[balefire plasma|Balefire Plasma]] to be used in a [[fusion reactor vessel|Fusion Reactor Vessel]].

See also:
[[Particle Accelerator]]
[[Fusion Reactor]]
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] cracked crude oil. Aromatic hydrocarbons are primarily used in the production of [[bakelite|Bakelite]] and [[solvent|Solvent]].

{{Template:Oil2}}
manual.hbm.fluids.biofuel.title: Biofuel
manual.hbm.fluids.biofuel.content: Biofuel can be obtained by combining [[biogas|Biogas]] and [[ethanol|Ethanol]] in a [[chemical plant|Chemical Plant]]. It is primarily used as a combustion [[fuel|Fuels]] for supplemental power production.
manual.hbm.fluids.biogas.title: Biogas
manual.hbm.fluids.biogas.content: Biogas can be obtained by [[combining|Chemical Plant]] biomass with [[compressed air|Compressed Air]]. Through [[mixing|Chemical Plant]] with [[ethanol|Ethanol]] it can be used to produce [[biofuel|Biofuel]]. Addtionally, it may also be used to create additional [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]] and [[aromatic hydrocarbons|Aromatic Hydrocarbons]]. It may also be produced by [[liquifying|Liquification Machine]] biomass.
manual.hbm.fluids.bitumen.title: Bitumen
manual.hbm.fluids.bitumen.content:
Bitumen can be primarily obtained through the [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] of [[heavy oil|Heavy Oil]]. It is primarily used for the production of asphalt, or the reproduction of [[crude oil|Crude Oil]] through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.blood.title: Blood
manual.hbm.fluids.blood.content: Blood can first be obtained by using an empty IV bag, however, this method will inflict damage. It can also be collected through a mob colliding with the [[turbofan|Turbofan]]. It is primarily used as an [[ICF|Inertial Confinement Reactor]] coolant, turning into hot blood when heated. It may also be converted to [[heavy oil|Heavy Oil]] by [[compressing|Compressor]] to '4PU'.
manual.hbm.fluids.btx.title: BTX
manual.hbm.fluids.btx.content:
BTX can be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[reformate|Reformate]] or [[desulfurized naphtha|Desulfurized Naphtha]]. It is primarily used to produce [[hard plastic|Hard Plastic]] when combined with [[phosgene]]. Later, it is used to produce [[crystalline fullerite|Crystalline Fullerite]] through [[acidizing|Ore Acidizer]] [[fullerine|Fullerine]]. It can be [[cracked|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] for additional [[aromatic hydrocarbons|Aromatic Hydrocarbons]] and [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.chlorine_gas.title: Chlorine Gas
manual.hbm.fluids.chlorine_gas.content:
Early methods of getting chlorine gas include using glowstone or [[sodalite|Sodalite]] obtained from lapis ore in the [[combination oven|Combination Oven]]. Alternatively, it can be made with an [[electrolysis machine|Electrolysis Machine]] or gradually over time with the chlorine pinwheel. It has many uses including [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]] and producing [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]]. One of its primary uses is the production of [[PVC]], or [[hard plastic|Hard Plastic]] through [[phosgene|Phosgene]].

See also:
[[Vacuum Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.fluids.chlorocalcite_solution:
Chlorocalcite solution can be obtained by [[processing|Chemical Plant]] chlorocalcite into a liquid. It is used in a long process to produce [[chlorine gas|Chlorine Gas]] and calcium powder.

This process requires converting mixing chlorocalcite solution with [[sulfuric acid|Sulfuric Acid]] and flux to obtain mixed chlorocalcite solution. It can then be [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] into [[colloid|Colloid]] and cleaned chlorocalcite solution. By [[processing|Chemical Plant]] the cleaned chlorocalcite solution with [[sulfuric acid|Sulfuric Acid]] it will produce potassium chloride solution and calcium chloride solution. The potassium chloride solution can be [[electrolyzed|Electrolysis Machine]] into [[chlorine gas|Chlorine Gas]]. The calcium chloride is also [[electrolyzed|Electrolysis Machine]] to produce [[chlorine gas|Chlorine Gas]] as well as calcium solution. Lastly, the calcium solution may be [[coked|Coker Unit]] to produce calcium powder and [[low-pressure steam|Steam]].
manual.hbm.fluids.cholesterol_solution.c: Cholesterol solution can be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[dissolved egg|Dissolved Egg]]. It is primarily used in the production of [[estradiol solution|Estradiol Solution]] and additional [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] through [[reforming|Catalytic Reformer]].
manual.hbm.fluids.coal_gasoline.title: Coal Gasoline
manual.hbm.fluids.coal_gasoline.content:
Coal gasoline is first obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[coal oil|Coal Oil]]. It is primarily used as a [[fuel|Fuels]] although it can be converted into [[leaded coal gasoline|Leaded Coal Gasoline]] for additional power output. It can also be obtained by performing [[pyrolysis|Pyrolysis Oven]] on [[heavy oil|Heavy Oil]] and coal.

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.fluids.coal_oil.title: Coal Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.coal_oil.content: Coal oil can first be obtained by [[liquifying|Liquification Machine]] coal or lignite. It is primarily used in the production of [[coal gasoline|Coal Gasoline]] through [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] or [[hydrotreating|Hydrotreater]]. Additionally, it is used in the production of [[syngas|Syngas]]. It can also be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[coal tar creosote|Coal Tar Creosote]].
manual.hbm.fluids.coal_tar_creosete.cont: Coal tar creosote can be made by coking any form of coal or lignite in a [[combination oven|Combination Oven]]. It is primarily [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] for [[coal oil|Coal Oil]] and [[bitumen|Bitumen]].
manual.hbm.fluids.coker_gas.title: Coker Gas
manual.hbm.fluids.coker_gas.content: Coker gas can be obtained by [[coking|Coker Unit]] various fluids. It is primarily used to create [[weapon steel|Weapon Steel]] in the [[rotary furnace|Rotary Furnace]]. It may also be [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] for [[aromatic hydrocarbons|Aromatic Hydrocarbons]] and [[carbon dioxide|Carbon Dioxide]].
manual.hbm.fluids.coker_naphtha.title: Coker Naphtha
manual.hbm.fluids.coker_naphtha.content: Coker naphtha can be obtained by [[coking|Coker Unit]] [[naphtha|Naphtha]] variants, various [[diesels|Diesel]], or [[reclaimed industrial oil|Reclaimed Industrial Oil]]. It can be [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] for [[cracked light oil|Cracked Light Oil]] and [[cracked naphtha|Cracked Naphtha]]. It may also be used as an ingredient in [[solvent|Solvent]] or [[reformed|Catalytic Reformer]] for [[reformate|Reformate]] and [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]].
manual.hbm.fluids.coker_oil.title: Coker Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.coker_oil.content: Coker oil can be obtained by [[coking|Coker Unit]] various oils. It can be used to produce additional [[cracked oil|Cracked Oil]] and [[heating oil|Heating Oil]].
manual.hbm.fluids.cracked_diesel.title: Cracked Diesel
manual.hbm.fluids.cracked_diesel.content:
Cracked diesel can be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[cracked naphtha|Cracked Naphtha]]. It is primarily used to obtain additional [[kerosene|Kerosene]] and [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]] through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] or [[radiolysis|Radiolysis Chamber]]. It may also be mixed to obtain [[high-cetane cracked diesel|High-Cetane Cracked Diesel]], a more powerful combustible [[fuel|Fuels]].

{{Template:Oil2}}
manual.hbm.fluids.cracked_light_oil.cont:
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] cracked crude oil. Cracked light oil has a variety of uses, it may be [[reformed|Catalytic Reformer]] or [[bred|Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber]] to obtain [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] and other byproducts. It may also be used as an alternate to [[light oil|Light Oil]] in the production of [[desh|Desh]]. It can also be [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]].

{{Template:Oil2}}
manual.hbm.fluids.cracked_naphtha.title: Cracked Naphtha
manual.hbm.fluids.cracked_naphtha.conten:
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] cracked crude oil. It is a key ingredient in the production of [[solvent|Solvent]]. Through [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]], cracked naphtha can additionally produce [[cracked diesel|Cracked Diesel]], a high fuel grade combustible. Cracked naphtha may also be [[reformed|Catalytic Reformer]] to obtain [[reformate|Reformate]] and other byproducts.

{{Template:Oil2}}
manual.hbm.fluids.cracked_oil.title: Cracked Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.cracked_oil.content:
Cracked oil can first be obtained through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] [[heated|Boiler]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. When [[refined|Oil Refinery]], it produces byproducts such as:
[[Cracked Naphtha]]
[[Cracked Light Oil]]
[[Aromatic Hydrocarbons]]
[[Unsaturated Hydrocarbons]]

It may also later be [[hydrotreated|Hydrotreater]] to obtain [[desfulfurized cracked oil|Desulfurized Cracked Oil]] for further processing.

{{Template:Oil2}}
manual.hbm.fluids.crude_oil.title: Crude Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.crude_oil.content:
Fluid obtained after extracting [[oil deposits|Oil Collection]]. Used as the base material for all oil products, it must first be [[heated|Boiler]] and [[processed|Oil Refinery]] to obtain products such as:
[[Heavy Oil]]
[[Naphtha]]
[[Light Oil]]
[[Petroleum Gas]]

It is also used to obtain [[cracked oil|Cracked Oil]] and related byproducts through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]]. Other methods of processing include [[vacuum refining|Vacuum Refinery]], [[radiolysis|Radiolysis]], [[hydrotreating|Hydrotreater]] and [[solidification|Solidification]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.desulfurized_cracked_o:
Desulfurized cracked oil can be produced by [[hydrotreating|Hydrotreater]] [[cracked oil|Cracked Oil]] with [[pressurized|Compressor]] [[liquid hydrogen|Liquid Hydrogen]]. After [[heating|Boiler]], it can be [[refined|Oil Refinery]] to produce products such as:
[[Desulfurized Naphtha]]
[[Desulfurized Light Oil]]
[[Aromatic Hydrocarbons]]
[[Unsaturated Hydrocarbons]]
[[Paraffin Wax]]

{{Template:Oil3.5}}
manual.hbm.fluids.desulfurized_crude_oil:
Desulfurized crude oil can be produced by [[hydrotreating|Hydrotreater]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]] with [[pressurized|Compressor]] [[liquid hydrogen|Liquid Hydrogen]]. It can be [[vacuum refined|Vacuum Refinery]] to produce products such as:
[[Vacuum Heavy Oil]]
[[Vacuum Light Oil]]
[[Reformate]]
[[Reformate Gas]]

It may also be [[heated|Boiler]] to obtain [[desulfurized hot crude oil|Desulfurized Hot Crude Oil]].

{{Template:Oil3.5}}
manual.hbm.fluids.desulfurized_hot_crude:
Desulfurized hot crude oil can be produced by [[heating|Boiler]] [[desulfurized crude oil|Desulfurized Crude Oil]]. It can be [[refined|Oil Refinery]] to produce products such as:
[[Heavy Oil]]
[[Desulfurized Naphtha]]
[[Desulfurized Light Oil]]
[[Unsaturated Hydrocarbons]]
[[Paraffin Wax]]

{{Template:Oil3.5}}
manual.hbm.fluids.desulfurized_light_oil:
Desulfurized light oil can be obtained by [[refining|Oil Refinery]] hot desulfurized [[cracked|Desulfurized Cracked Oil]] or [[crude|Desulfurized Hot Crude Oil]] oil. It may be [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] to produce [[high-cetane diesel|High-Cetane Diesel]] and [[kerosene|Kerosene]].

{{Template:Oil3.5}}
manual.hbm.fluids.desulfurized_naphtha.c:
Desulfurized naphtha can be obtained by [[refining|Oil Refinery]] hot desulfurized [[cracked|Desulfurized Cracked Oil]] or [[crude|Desulfurized Hot Crude Oil]] oil. It is primarily [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] to produce [[BTX]] and [[high-cetane diesel|High-Cetane Diesel]]. It may also be mixed with [[aromatic hydrocarbons|Aromatic Hydrocarbons]] to obtain additional [[solvent|Solvent]].

{{Template:Oil3.5}}
manual.hbm.fluids.deuterium.title: Deuterium
manual.hbm.fluids.deuterium.content: Deuterium can be made by [[electrolyzing|Electrolysis Machine]] [[heavy water|Heavy Water]]. It is primarily used to produce various plasmas inside the [[fusion reactor|Fusion Reactor]].
manual.hbm.fluids.diesel.title: Diesel
manual.hbm.fluids.diesel.content:
Diesel can be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[light oil|Light Oil]] or [[naphtha|Naphtha]]. It is primarily used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] source, however it may also be [[cracked|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] for additional [[kerosene|Kerosene]] and [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.dissolved_egg.title: Dissolved Egg
manual.hbm.fluids.dissolved_egg.content: Dissolved egg can be obtained by mixing [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]] and an egg. It is used to produce [[cholesterol solution|Cholesterol Solution]] through [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]]. It also returns some of the input [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]].
manual.hbm.fluids.engine_lubricant.title: Engine Lubricant
manual.hbm.fluids.engine_lubricant.conte:
Engine lubricant is primarily obtained from [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[industrial oil|Industrial Oil]]. It can be used to produce [[paraffin wax|Paraffin Wax]] which allows for early production of [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]] or the production of [[petroil|Petroil]]. It is also required to lubricate the [[combined cycle gas turbine|Combined Cycle Gas Turbine]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.fish_oil.title: Fish Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.fish_oil.content: Fish oil can be made by mixing or [[liquifying|Liquification Machine]] any type of fish. It is primarily used to produce a variety of fluids such as [[nitroglycerin|Nitroglycerin]], [[engine lubricant|Engine Lubricant]], or [[biofuel|Biofuel]] through mixing.
manual.hbm.fluids.gasoline.title: Gasoline
manual.hbm.fluids.gasoline.content:
Gasoline is obtained through [[processing|Chemical Plant]] [[naphtha|Naphtha]]. It is primarily used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]]. It may also be mixed into [[leaded gasoline|Leaded Gasoline]] for more power production.

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.heating_oil.title: Heating Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.heating_oil.content:
Heating oil can first be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[naphtha|Naphtha]] or [[industrial oil|Industrial Oil]]. It is primarily used as an ingredient in [[engine lubricant|Engine Lubricant]] or as an early [[fuel|Fuels]] source.

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.heavy_heating_oil.cont:
Heavy heating oil can be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[vacuum heavy oil|Vacuum Heavy Oil]]. It is used to produce additional [[heating oil|Heating Oil]] and [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] or [[radiolysis|Radiolysis]]. It is also commonly used as a [[fuel|Fuels]] source for supplemental power production.

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.heavy_oil.title: Heavy Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.heavy_oil.content:
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. Heavy oil is a byproduct that is typically voided early on or [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] and refined further to create asphalt. It may also be processed directly into [[engine lubricant|Engine Lubricant]] or [[oil tar|Oil Tar]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.high_cetane_cracked_di:
High-cetane cracked diesel is made by mixing [[reformate|Reformate]] and [[cracked diesel|Cracked Diesel]]. It is used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] source. It may also be [[hydrotreated|Hydrotreater]] to obtain [[high-cetane diesel|High-Cetane Diesel]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.high_cetane_diesel.con:
High-cetane diesel can first be obtained by mixing [[reformate|Reformate]] and [[diesel|Diesel]]. It is used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] source. It may also be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[desulfurized naphtha|Desulfurized Naphtha]] or [[desulfurized light oil|Desulfurized Light Oil]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.high_performance_solve:
Obtained from either combining [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] with [[chlorine gas|Chlorine Gas]] or by [[breeding|RBMK Irradiation Channel]] [[chlorinated petroleum wax|Chlorinated Petroleum Wax]]. Both methods of producing high-performance solvent require a [[RBMK]] to produce due to the prerequisite of [[bismuth|Bismuth]] for [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] or the use of the [[irradiation channel|RBMK Irradiation Channel]]. High-Performance Solvent is primarily used for advanced [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]] or the production of [[fullerene solution|Fullerene Solution]] for [[crystalline fullerite|Crystalline Fullerite]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.hydrogen_peroxide.cont: Hydrogen peroxide can be obtained through [[processing|Chemical Plant]] [[water|Water]]. It is one of the most vital fluids as it is used in every stage of progression. It is first used to process materials in the [[ore acidizer|Ore Acidizer]]. It is used in the production of [[sulfuric acid|Sulfuric Acid]], [[coltan processing|Tantalite Production]], and [[ferric schrabidate|Schrabidic Acid]] production. It may also be used to produce [[capacitor boards|Circuits]].
manual.hbm.fluids.industrial_oil.title: Industrial Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.industrial_oil.content:
Industrial Oil can be obtained through [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[heavy oil|Heavy Oil]]. It is primarily used to obtain [[engine lubricant|Engine Lubricant]] and [[heating oil|Heating Oil]] through [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]]. It may also be used to produce additional [[naphtha|Naphtha]] or [[reclaimed industrial oil|Reclaimed Industrial Oil]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.jet_fuel.title: Jet Fuel
manual.hbm.fluids.jet_fuel.content:
Jet fuel is primarily obtained by mixing [[reformate|Reformate]] and [[kerosene|Kerosene]]. Jet fuel is primarily used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] for additional power. It may also be obtained by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[desulfurized light oil|Desulfurized Light Oil]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.kerosene.title: Kerosene
manual.hbm.fluids.kerosene.content:
Kerosene can be produced by [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[light oil variants|Light Oil]], [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] or performing [[radiolysis|Radiolysis Chamber]] on [[diesel variants|Diesel]]. Kerosene is used for a variety of functions including [[balefire plasma|Balefire Plasma]], as a solvent for depleted, radioactive fuels in the [[purex|Purex]], refueling most jetpacks, or as a combustion [[fuel|Fuels]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.leaded_coal_gasoline.c:
Leaded coal gasoline can be obtained by mixing [[tetraethyllead antiknock agent|Tetraethyllead Antiknock Agent]] with [[coal gasoline|Coal Gasoline]]. It can be used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]].

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.fluids.leaded_gasoline.title: Leaded Gasoline
manual.hbm.fluids.leaded_gasoline.conten:
Leaded gasoline can be obtained by mixing [[tetraethyllead antiknock agent|Tetraethyllead Antiknock Agent]] with [[gasoline|Gasoline]]. Leaded gasoline can be used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]].

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.fluids.leaded_petroil.title: Leaded Petroil
manual.hbm.fluids.leaded_petroil.content:
Leaded petroil can be obtained from mixing [[petroil|Petroil]] and [[tetraethyllead antiknock agent|Tetraethyllead Antiknock Agent]]. It can only be used as a [[fuel|Fuels]] source for additional power.

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.fluids.light_oil.title: Light Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.light_oil.content:
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. Light oil is primarily used to make [[desh|Desh]]. It can also be [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] to obtain fuels such as [[diesel|Diesel]] or [[kerosene|Kerosene]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.lpg.title: LPG
manual.hbm.fluids.lpg.content:
LPG can be produced by [[compressing|Compressor]] [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]] to '1PU'. It is primarily used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] source.

See also:
[[Advanced Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.fluids.mercury.title: Mercury
manual.hbm.fluids.mercury.content: Mercury can first be obtained by [[centrifuging|Centrifuge]] redstone ore. It is primarily used in the production of [[desh|Desh]]. It is also used in [[NITAN© 100 octane super fuel|NITAN© 100 Octane Super Fuel]]. Additionally, it is commonly made by inserting cinnabar into a [[combination over|Combination Oven]] or through [[red mud|Red Mud]] processing.
manual.hbm.fluids.mustard_gas.title: Mustard Gas
manual.hbm.fluids.mustard_gas.content: Mustard gas can be obtained by mixing [[chlorine gas|Chlorine Gas]] and [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] with sulfur. It is used to make certain [[artillery shells|Artillery Shells]].
manual.hbm.fluids.naphtha.title: Naphtha
manual.hbm.fluids.naphtha.content:
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. Naphtha can be used to make early fuels such as [[gasoline|Gasoline]] or [[diesel|Diesel]]. Later, it may also be used to produce [[solvent|Solvent]] for [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.nitan100_octane_super_: NITAN© 100 octane super fuel can be produced by mixing [[mercury|Mercury]], [[kerosene|Kerosene]], and nitanium blend together. It is used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] source for power production.
manual.hbm.fluids.nitroglycerin.title: Nitroglycerin
manual.hbm.fluids.nitroglycerin.content: Nitroglycerin can be produced by mixing [[nitric acid|Nitric Acid]] with either [[fish oil|Fish Oil]] or [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]]. Through [[acidizing|Ore Acidizer]] it can be used to produce dynamite when mixed with quartz powder, or cordite when mixed with sawdust.
manual.hbm.fluids.osmiridic_solution.con: Osmiridic solution is a post-gerald fluid that can be made from paleogenite powder and other materials in a [[chemical plant|Chemical Plant]]. It may be split with gamma waves in a [[SILEX]] to obtain impure osmiridium powder.
manual.hbm.fluids.oxyhydrogen.title: Oxyhydrogen
manual.hbm.fluids.oxyhydrogen.content: Oxyhydrogen can be made by mixing [[liquid hydrogen|Liquid Hydrogen]] with [[liquid oxygen|Liquid Oxygen]] or [[compressed air|Compressed Air]]. It may be used as a [[fuel|Fuels]] source for supplemental power, although minimal.
manual.hbm.fluids.petroil.title: Petroil
manual.hbm.fluids.petroil.content:
Petroil can be obtained through mixing [[engine lubricant|Engine Lubricant]] and [[reclaimed industrial oil|Reclaimed Industrial Oil]]. It is primarily used as [[fuel|Fuels]] source, or as an ingredient in [[leaded petroil|Leaded Petroil]].

See also:
[[Basic Oil Processing]]
manual.hbm.fluids.petroleum_gas.title: Petroleum Gas
manual.hbm.fluids.petroleum_gas.content:
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. Petroleum gas is the main ingredient in [[polymer|Polymer]], [[bakelite|Bakelite]], and [[perfluoromethyl|Perfluoromethyl]] making it a key ingredient for progression in all stages of the game. It is also the primary fluid used in [[fracking solution|Fracking Solution]].

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.reclaimed_industrial_o:
Reclaimed industrial oil can be obtained through [[processing|Chemical Plant]] [[industrial oil|Industrial Oil]]. It can be used as an ingredient in [[petroil|Petroil]] or as a [[fuel|Fuels]] source for supplemental power.

{{Template:Oil1}}
manual.hbm.fluids.reformate.title: Reformate
manual.hbm.fluids.reformate.content:
Reformate can be obtained by [[vacuum refining|Vacuum Refinery]] [[pressurized|Compressor]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. It has a diverse selection of uses including the production of [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] or [[radiolysis|Radiolysis Chamber]]. Another notable use is the production of [[BTX]] through [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]]. Additionally, it is a key ingredient in both [[high-cetane diesel|High-Cetane Diesel]] and [[high-cetane cracked diesel|High-Cetane Cracked Diesel]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.reformate_gas.title: Reformate Gas
manual.hbm.fluids.reformate_gas.content:
Reformate gas can be obtained by a variety of methods after setting up [[vacuum oil processing|Vacuum Oil Processing]]. Its primary uses include the production of [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]] and [[welding|Arc Welder]] [[cast combine steel plates|Combine Steel]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.solvent.title: Solvent
manual.hbm.fluids.solvent.content:
Solvent is obtained by combining any [[naphtha|Naphtha]] variant and [[aromatic hydrocarbons|Aromatic Hydrocarbons]]. It has multiple uses including [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]] and advanced circuit production.

{{Template:Oil2}}
manual.hbm.fluids.sour_gas.title: Sour Gas
manual.hbm.fluids.sour_gas.content:
Sour gas is first obtained by [[vacuum refining|Vacuum Refinery]] [[pressurized|Compressor]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. It is used in a variety of applications including the production of [[TATB]], and the [[conversion|Ore Acidizer]] of [[latex|Latex]] to [[rubber|Rubber]]. It may also be obtained by [[hydrotreating|Hydrotreater]] various [[oil|Crude Oil]] and [[diesel|Cracked Diesel]] variants.

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.steam.title: Steam
manual.hbm.fluids.steam.content:
Steam can be obtained by [[heating|Boiler]] [[water|Water]]. This method can be done through the [[RBMK steam channel|RBMK Steam Channel]] or the [[boiler|Boiler]]. It also has many variants depending on how hot it is. Ultra dense steam is the hottest, followed by super dense steam, then dense steam, steam, and lastly low-pressure steam. Any level higher than low-pressure can be produced from [[water|Water]] in the [[RBMK steam channel|RBMK Steam Channel]].

It is impossible to increase the density and level of steam and it therefore must be produced in the desired tier. It is possible to lower the tier of the steam through the use of a [[steam turbine|Steam Turbine]]. Each turbine will lower the tier by one, meaning that ultra dense will require four [[turbines|Steam Turbine]] to go down to low-pressure steam.

Low-pressure steam may be converted back into [[water|Water]] through [[condensing|Condenser]] allowing for the creation of a complete cooling loop. Low-pressure steam is also produced from the [[cracking tower|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] as a byproduct from the required steam input.

Some machines only output certain tiers of steam, such as the [[ZIRNOX]] and [[fusion reactor boiler|Fusion Reactor Boiler]] only producing super dense steam.
manual.hbm.fluids.sulfuric_acid.title: Sulfuric Acid
manual.hbm.fluids.sulfuric_acid.content:
Sulfuric acid is first obtained my mixing [[hydrogen peroxide|Hydrogen Peroxide]] with [[water|Water]] and sulfur. It is one of the most vital fluids as it is used in every stage of progression.
It is first used to [[acidize|Ore Acidizer]] ores into crystals. It is also a key part of [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]]. Additionally, it is used to dissolve some radioactive fuels in the [[purex|Purex]]. Sulfuric acid is also used in the production of [[military grade circuit boards|Military Grade Circuit Boards]]. Lastly, it may be mixed to produce [[fracking solution|Fracking Solution]] or [[nitric acid|Nitric Acid]] for [[bedrock ore|Bedrock Ore Processing]] and [[bedrock oil|Bedrock Oil Processing]] processing. It may also be obtained by [[coking|Coker Unit]] or [[electrolysing|Electrolysis Machine]] [[vitriol|Vitriol]].
manual.hbm.fluids.sunflower_seed_oil.con: Sunflower seed oil can be obtained by [[liquifying|Liquification Machine]] or mixing sunflowers. It is primarily used in the production of [[biofuel|Biofuel]] or [[engine lubricant|Engine Lubricant]] through mixing.

manual.hbm.fluids.type_fuels.title: Fuels
manual.hbm.fluids.type_fuels.content:
There are a variety of different fuels, available each with different characteristics. Each fuel has a §e[Flammable] and §6[Combustible] value.

The §e[Flammable] value corresponds to how much heat is gained from burning each fuel in either a [[fluid burner|Fluid Burner]] or [[flare stack|Flare Stack]].

The §6[Combustible] value is how much power can be gained from igniting each fluid. This can be done with the [[diesel generator|Diesel Generator]], the [[industrial combustion engine|Industrial Combustion Engine]], or the [[combined cycle gas turbine|Combined Cycle Gas Turbine]].

Each fuel is also associated with a combustion fuel grade. The fuel grade corresponds to which [[piston set|Piston Sets]] is the most efficient. There are five fuel grades available along with four [[piston sets|Piston Sets]] that have varying efficiencies. The piston set most optimal for each fuel can be used in an [[industrial combustion engine|Industrial Combustion Engine]] to generate power from the fuel.

manual.hbm.fluids.unsaturated_hydrocarbo:
Obtained after [[refining|Oil Refinery]] [[heated|Boiler]] cracked crude oil. Unsaturated hydrocarbons are used in both [[rubber|Rubber]] and [[perfluoromethyl|Perfluoromethyl]]. It is also used in both [[PVC|PVC]] directly, and [[hard plastic|Hard Plastic]] through the production of [[phosgene|Phosgene]].

{{Template:Oil2}}
manual.hbm.fluids.vacuum_heavy_oil.title: Vacuum Heavy Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.vacuum_heavy_oil.conte:
Vacuum heavy oil can be obtained by [[vacuum refinining|Vacuum Refinery]] [[pressurized|Compressor]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. It is primarily [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] for [[heavy heating oil|Heavy Heating Oil]] and [[industrial oil|Industrial Oil]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.vacuum_light_oil.title: Vacuum Light Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.vacuum_light_oil.conte:
Vacuum light oil can be obtained by [[vacuum refining|Vacuum Refinery]] [[pressurized|Compressor]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. It is primarily [[fractioned|Fractioning Tower]] into [[kerosene|Kerosene]] and [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]].

{{Template:Oil3}}
manual.hbm.fluids.wood_oil.title: Wood Oil
manual.hbm.fluids.wood_oil.content: Wood oil can be obtained by as a byproduct from logs, saplings, or sawdust briquettes in a [[combination oven|Combination Oven]]. It may be used to produce additional [[heating oil|Heating Oil]] and [[aromatic hydrocarbons|Aromatic Hydrocarbons]] through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] or [[radiolysis|Radiolysis Chamber]]. It can also be mixed with [[fish oil|Fish Oil]] or [[sunflower seed oil|Sunflower Seed Oil]] to make [[biofuel|Biofuel]].
manual.hbm.fluids.xenon_gas.title: Xenon Gas
manual.hbm.fluids.xenon_gas.content: Xenon gas can be obtained by [[processing|Chemical Plant]] [[compressed air|Compressed Air]]. It is primarily used as an ingredient in the entanglement kit used in teleporters. It is also used as an ingredient in the [[ICF|Inertial Confinement Fusion Reactor]]. Additionally, it may also be used in the winged variant of [[lunar cybernetic armor|Lunar Cybernetic Armor]].
manual.hbm.fusion.boiler.title: Fusion Reactor Boiler
manual.hbm.fusion.boiler.content:
Simplest energy-extracting component of a [[fusion reactor|Fusion Reactor]], uses the plasma output energy (measured in TU/t) from the [[torus|Fusion Reactor Vessel]] to boil water into [[super dense steam|Super Dense Steam]]. Each mB of water uses 200TU to boil, as a boiler would, however, the fusion reactor boiler produces a higher compression level of steam directly, making it more efficient than conventional boilers.

Due to using plasma energy, boilers are affected by port sharing rules, meaning that having multiple connected boilers (or [[MHDTs|MHD Turbine]]) decreases the amount of energy each boiler gets, but overall increases the total amount extracted from the torus.

{{Template:Fusion}}
manual.hbm.fusion.breeder.title: Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber
manual.hbm.fusion.breeder.content:
Uses neutron flux from a fusion reactor's [[torus|Fusion Reactor Vessel]] in order to process materials. Can perform any recipe from the [[RBMK irradiation channel|RBMK Irradiation Channel]], plus a few unique recipes with liquid inputs. Neutron flux output is not affected by port sharing rules, the neutron flux output level on a torus is constant across all ports no matter how many components are attached to it.

{{Template:Fusion}}
manual.hbm.fusion.collector.title: Fusion Reactor Collector Chamber
manual.hbm.fusion.collector.content:
Can be attached to a fusion reactor's [[torus|Fusion Reactor Vessel]] in order to increase the byproduct production rate by 50%. The byproducts are extracted from the torus itself, the collector does not have a GUI, nor ports. The collector also does not use the plasma's flux or energy level, so other components affected by energy sharing are unaffected.

{{Template:Fusion}}
manual.hbm.fusion.coupler.title: Fusion Reactor Coupler
manual.hbm.fusion.coupler.content:
Small and unassuming, yet the most powerful part of a [[fusion reactor|Fusion Reactor]] setup, the coupler turns outgoing plasma energy from a [[torus|Fusion Reactor Vessel]] into usable klystron energy which can be used as the power source for another torus. Some fuel combinations require this, as the minimum klystron energy needed to ignite the plasma exceeds what four [[klystrons|Klystron]] could deliver.

Affected by port sharing rules, keep in mind that the coupler's output will be affected when using [[boilers|Fusion Reactor Boiler]] or [[MHDTs|MHD Turbine]] on the torus it draws power from.

{{Template:Fusion}}
manual.hbm.fusion.fusionreactor.title: Fusion Reactor
manual.hbm.fusion.fusionreactor.content:
A powerful and versatile reactor that fuses light elements into heavier ones. Depending on the setup, reactors may be specialized to make as much power as possible, or to make a lot of byproducts efficiently.

Components:
* [[Fusion Reactor Vessel]]: Core component, this is where the plasma is created
* [[Klystron]]: Primary energy source
* [[Fusion Reactor Collector Chamber]]: Increases byproduct yield
* [[Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber]]: Uses neutron flux from the vessel to process materials
* [[Fusion Reactor Boiler]]: Uses plasma energy to boil water
* [[MHD Turbine]]: Uses plasma energy to generate electricity directly
* [[Fusion Reactor Coupler]]: Uses plasma energy to generate usable klystron energy, allowing plasma vessels to be chained

The most basic setup for a fusion reactor is a single plasma vessel ("torus"), supplied with power and [[perfluoromethyl|Perfluoromethyl]] cooling, and an air-cooled klystron to ignite its plasma. Depending on its purpose, power-generating parts such as boilers and MHDTs, or byproduct-yielding parts like collectors and breeders may be added.

More advanced setups may employ couplers to create the energy needed to ignite higher-tier plasmas, creating a setup with two ore more toruses. Byproducts from lower stages can be used for certain higher tier plasma types, so one torus may provide both ignition energy and fuel for another.

{{Template:Fusion}}
manual.hbm.fusion.klystron.title: Klystron
manual.hbm.fusion.klystron.content:
Main power source of a [[fusion reactor|Fusion Reactor]], uses electricity and [[compressed air|Compressed Air]] to generate input energy (klystron energy or KyU) for the connected [[torus|Fusion Reactor Vessel]]. The output target needs to be defined in the GUI. Will throttle if either the buffered electricity or compressed air falls below 50%. If the klystron's output falls below the connected torus' required input level, it will not throttle, rather the plasma will immediately extinguish.

{{Template:Fusion}}
manual.hbm.fusion.mhdt.title: MHD Turbine
manual.hbm.fusion.mhdt.content:
Magnetohydrodynamic turbines are advanced components of the [[fusion reactor|Fusion Reactor]] that make electric energy out of plasma energy directly without needing steam or turbines, as a [[boiler|Fusion Reactor Boiler]] would. While more expensive and requiring [[perfluoromethyl|Perfluoromethyl]] cooling, they do have an innate +35% conversion bonus from TU to HE. In addition, the MHD turbine requires a minimum input of 5MTU/t of plasma energy to operate normally, otherwise efficiency will be halved.

Due to using plasma energy, MHDTs are affected by port sharing rules, meaning that having multiple connected MHDTs (or boilers) decreases the amount of energy each turbine gets, but overall increases the total amount extracted from the torus.

MHDTs do in fact not have any moving parts, instead the large rotating copper wheel is part of its cooling system. Ya dweeb.

manual.hbm.fusion.torus.title: Fusion Reactor Vessel
manual.hbm.fusion.torus.content:
"Torus", main component of the [[fusion reactor|Fusion Reactor]], uses fuel and energy from a [[klystron|Klystron]] to generate plasma. Also requires electricity and cooling via [[perfluoromethyl|Perfluoromethyl]] to operate.

Features four connection ports for external components. Devices that use plasma energy (and not just neutron flux) split the total output, a single component will receive 100% of the energy, two components will receive 62.5% each and three components get 50% each. Therefore, using multiple [[boilers|Fusion Reactor Boiler]] or [[MHDTs|MHD Turbine]] increases the total energy output, although with diminishing returns. Flux levels are not affected when shared, the output remains steady across all ports no matter how many attachments are used.

Both the buffered electric charge and fuel levels determine working speed, if either is below 50%, the reactor will start to throttle, burning slower and decreasing output energy. The klystron energy does not affect processing speed, too little energy will simply fail to ignite the plasma, and more energy will not accelerate the reaction.

{{Template:Fusion}}
manual.hbm.guide.oil.title: Oil Collection
manual.hbm.guide.oil.content:
Oil can be found in two forms: Oil deposits and bedrock oil.

Oil deposits spawn like ores but shouldn't be mined, rather they require a [[derrick|Derrick]] or [[pumpjack|Pumpjack]] on the surface to dig down and extract the oil. The deposits can be found either when mining, or from the surface by using an oil deposit detector. The detector scans a small radius for oil, and also gives a notification when there's a deposit directly below. Oil deposits will last a while, but are ultimately finite.

Bedrock oil cannot be located this way, instead it is marked on the surface by patches of oily dirt or sand. Bedrock oil is infinite, however it requires a specialized [[hydraulic fracking tower|Hydraulic Fracking Tower]] to be extracted, which needs [[fracking solution|Fracking Solution]] to work.

{{Template:Oil}}
manual.hbm.guide.oil1.title: Basic Oil Processing
manual.hbm.guide.oil1.content:
Basic oil processing ("Oil 1") involves separating [[crude oil|Crude Oil]] using a [[refinery|Oil Refinery]].

For this you will need:
[[Boiler]]
[[External Heat Source]]
[[Oil Refinery]]
[[Fractioning Tower]]

Connect your source of crude oil to the boiler. Set the boiler's input type to crude oil by right-clicking it with a fluid identifier. Power up the boiler using a heat source (like a [[firebox|Firebox]]) and pipe the resulting hot crude oil into the refinery.

Most resulting oils can be split once more with a fractioning tower. Once again use a fluid identifier to set the fractioning tower's input type, then connect it with the refinery.

This process will yield the following fluids:
[[Petroleum Gas]] (for plastics and various other uses)
[[Bitumen]] (for asphalt)
[[Heating Oil]] (mostly for burning)
[[Industrial Oil]] (may be processed into [[petroil|Petroil]])
[[Engine Lubricant]] (for various uses)
[[Diesel]] (powerful early engine [[fuel|Fuels]])
[[Kerosene]] (powerful [[fuel|Fuels]])

These resources enable the creation of some new materials:
[[Polymer]] from [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]]
[[Gasoline]] out of [[naphtha|Naphtha]]
[[Desh]] using [[light oil|Light Oil]]
[[LPG]], a compressed form of [[petroleum gas|Petroleum Gas]], powerful [[fuel|Fuels]]

{{Template:Oil}}
manual.hbm.guide.oil2.title: Advanced Oil Processing
manual.hbm.guide.oil2.content:
Advanced oil processing ("Oil 2") involves turning [[crude oil|Crude Oil]] into [[cracked oil|Cracked Oil]] using a [[catalytic cracking tower|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] and separating it using a [[refinery|Oil Refinery]].

For this you will need:
[[Boiler]]
[[External Heat Source]]
[[Condenser]]
[[Oil Refinery]]
[[Catalytic Cracking Tower]]
[[Fractioning Tower]]

Connect your source of crude oil to the cracking tower. Also supply the cracking tower with [[steam|Steam]], produced by a boiler. Pipe the resulting [[low-pressure steam|Steam]] into a condenser, and loop the [[water|Water]] back into the boiler (closed loop steam cycle). The cracking tower also creates petroleum gas, ready for use, and cracked oil. Heat the cracked oil in a boiler and pipe it into the refinery. Two of the resulting fluids can be separated further using the fractioning towers.

This process will yield the following fluids:
[[Heating Oil]] (for burning)
[[Cracked Diesel]] (a lower power form of [[diesel|Diesel]])
[[Kerosene]] (powerful [[fuel|Fuels]])
[[Petroleum Gas]] (for plastics)
[[Aromatic Hydrocarbons]] (for plastics and explosives)
[[Unsaturated Hydrocarbons]] (for plastics, burns incredibly hot)

These resources enable the creation of some new materials:
[[Rubber]] made from unsaturateds and [[sulfur|Sulfur]]
[[Bakelite]] as a cheap [[polymer|Polymer]] substitute
[[TNT]] from aromatics
[[C4]] from unsaturateds

The [[coker unit|Coker Unit]] ("Oil 2.5") can turn many oil products into [[petroleum coke|Coke]] with a byproduct, these byproducts can often be processed into cracked oil derivatives.

{{Template:Oil}}
manual.hbm.guide.oil3.title: Vacuum Oil Processing
manual.hbm.guide.oil3.content:
Vacuum oil processing ("Oil 3") requires [[oil|Crude Oil]] to be [[compressed|Compressor]] and then processed in a [[vacuum refinery|Vacuum Refinery]]. Due to the refinery requiring [[bismuth|Bismuth]] to be made, vacuum refining can only be done once an [[RBMK]] has been built.

For this you will need:
Two [[compressors|Compressor]]
[[Vacuum Refinery]]
[[Fractioning Tower]]

Connect your source of crude oil to a compressor, then connect that compressor to a second compressor configured to "1 PU -> 2PU". This compressed crude oil then has to be piped into the vacuum refinery. Like before, most of the results can be fractioned again using the fractioning towers.

This process will yield the following fluids:
[[Heavy Heating Oil]] for burning
[[Reformate]] as blending stock for high-power fuels
[[BTX]] for making [[hard plastic|Hard Plastic]] and [[fullerite|Fullerite]]
[[Sour Gas]] for [[TATB]] or as a source of [[sulfur|Sulfur]]
[[Reformate Gas]] as a powerful fuel, for [[saturnite|Saturnite]] and late-game welding

These resources enable the creation of some new materials:
[[Hard Plastic]] made from BTX
[[TATB]] as a better form of [[TNT]] used in nuclear bombs
[[Saturnite]] for making weapon parts

Once [[bismuth|Bismuth]] has been obtained, different paths to making vacuum oils become available ("Oil 3.5"). The [[hydrotreater|Hydrotreater]] can use [[hydrogen|Hydrogen]] to turn cracked oil products into their non-cracked counterparts, or desulfurize oil which can be processed in a standard [[refinery|Oil Refinery]] to make vacuum oil products. The [[catalytic reformer|Catalytic Reformer]] can process less valuable oils into more desirable ones like reformate, reformate gas, aromatic hydrocarbons and petroleum gas.
